target: parsec multi-agent bundle (orchestrator.md + 6 domain agents + shared_context.md; capabilities: [system-prompt]) -- the ORIGINAL, unmodified skill, zero-shot, 5 trials/task, no optimization step

task_ledger.audit_note: dead trial(s) excluded after per-trial audit: AgentTimeoutError with 0 tool calls (gateway hang before the first LLM response); cap-evolve scored them 0.0 and did not count them as errored

set_difference.note: About half the gap is composition: 10-10 contains the 21 h4-rewritten tasks, which the original skill now finds easy (see by_origin); without them the gap roughly halves. The remainder is borderline. Split o5/h5 stratified by task_set and category rather than purely at random.

comparison_v4.note: Same task ids, same original skill, task contracts unchanged between v4_2026-09-16 and v5 (instructions 0/34 changed, contracts 1/34). v4_t1 is v4's own original-skill baseline (n=3), JB is the external baseline-v2 (n=1). This is the reproducibility check for the whole v5 rebuild.

provenance.source_generator: parsec-intake_v5 worktree: scripts/parsec/v5/collect.py, then a per-trial audit of all 680 trials (gitignored there -- vendored here as a frozen snapshot)

audit.tool: per-trial audit of harbor result.json / verifier / transcript for all 680 trials
audit.rule: a trial is dead if harbor raised (AgentTimeoutError) or the agent's final event is_error; such trials are excluded and counted as errored, never scored 0
